subject: [COMPANY] & Encord
text:
Hi 
       [NAME],

subject: Deploy AI agents in minutes
text:
Hi [NAME],

Given [COMPANY]'s work in GenAI, I thought this might be relevant.

We're hosting a 30-min live session on Mar 17 showing how teams deploy production-ready agents (e.g. Whisper, GPT, Claude) directly into their ML pipelines to automate annotation and eval - no self-hosting or custom integration required. 

GenAI teams are using it to automate transcription, video classification, and data extraction, cutting what used to take days of engineering to a single deploy.

Register here

subject: Data collection for multi-camera streams
text:
Hi [NAME],

Recently caught up with Ishan - understand that multi-camera, multi-view data collection is top of mind for the foundational model team right now.

We're helping several AV teams solve that by providing a single platform where they can ingest synchronized multi-camera streams, annotate across all views simultaneously with AI-assisted labeling and HITL review.

Would you be available to connect later this week or early next with our Head of Robotics Operations and Physical AI leadership? Wednesday-Friday mornings (ET) are currently quite open for us.
